subject: Strategic request: priority dedicated capacity, transient H200 burst, and overage cap for OptimaAI go-live
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@optimaai.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Green <maya.green@optimaai.com>, procurement@optimaai.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: priority dedicated capacity + burst for OptimaAI go-live

Hi Neha —

We have a hard go-live for a major customer on 2027-10-03 and we need a short-term dedicated capacity arrangement to avoid a launch outage. Summary: we need 8 H200-class GPUs (or closest equivalent) reserved and prioritized for a 3-week window starting 2027-09-25, with a 4-week transient burst buffer in case the roll-out needs one extra week. Key asks:
- Temporary reservation hold so capacity isn't preempted during the window
- Priority routing to H200; fallback to H100 only if absolutely necessary
- Overage billing cap or discounted overage rate negotiated for the transient period

Attached: OptimaAI_capacity_request_sheet.xlsx (numbers) and our MSA redline. We understand this is non-standard but this launch is strategic for OptimaAI (they will expand to a committed Dedicated contract if this goes well).

Can Redwood provide an exec signoff or escalation path for this request? We need an answer by EOD Monday (2027-09-13) to lock our internal launch plan.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Infrastructure
OptimaAI
Attachment: OptimaAI_MSA_redline_v3.pdf
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@optimaai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: priority dedicated capacity + burst for OptimaAI go-live

Sanjay —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. I copied Kar and Lauren for deal-desk / exec review and Aditya for capacity planning. We'll need a couple quick clarifications to build the proposal for signoff:
- Confirm the exact peak concurrent slots required (sheet says 8 H200-equivalent, please confirm if 8 is sustained or peak).
- Can you commit to the 3-week reserved window (2027-09-25 to 2027-10-15) as the primary window and list acceptable fallback dates?
- Any compliance constraints requiring private-only deployment (VPC/on-prem)?

Next steps: I'll loop this internally and request an executive exception for transient priority and an overage cap. If approved, we'll produce a short addendum to the MSA (DocuSign link to follow).

I understand the Monday timeline — we'll treat this as high urgency.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Director, Sales, Redwood Inference
On Fri, Sep 10, 2027 at 09:22 AM Sanjay Patel <sanjay@optimaai.com> wrote:
> (original message attached)
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: OptimaAI - exec signoff request: H200 priority & overage cap

Team — forwarding Optima's request. Quick summary and what I need from you:

Summary:
- Customer: OptimaAI (related_account)
- Ask: Temporary priority access to H200-class dedicated capacity (8 GPUs), reservation hold for launch window, 3-week primary window + up to 4-week transient buffer
- Billing ask: discounted overage rate for transient usage and an explicit cap so Optima isn't surprised
- Docs: MSA redline attached + capacity spreadsheet (see related_links)
- Deal: large potential expansion to Reserved Dedicated contract following a successful launch

Required approvals (please reply inline):
1) Hardware priority and reservation hold for 21 days (can we set a soft hold that prevents preemption?) — need capacity ops confirmation from Aditya; approval from Lauren (deal terms) and Kar (exec pricing)
2) Overage rate concession: Optima asks for a flat cap on overage charges for the transient period. Propose a capped surcharge at X% above committed rate or a fixed-dollar cap. Need Kar's pricing signoff and Lauren's legal view on addendum language.
3) MSA redlines: legal to handle but we should sign off commercial terms first.

Why fast-track: launch is strategic and could convert to a multi-quarter Dedicated commit. Risk: precedence for other customers if we make the concession too broad. Proposed guardrails attached in RDW_transient_addendum_optima.docx.

Links: JIRA RDW-2219 (deal-tracking) and docsign draft: https://redwood.app/docsign/optima-2027-137

Please respond with approvals or questions; Optima needs a yes/no by Monday EOD 2027-09-13.

— Neha
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 13:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: OptimaAI - exec signoff request: H200 priority & overage cap

Neha / team —

I've reviewed the ask and the attached guardrails. I'm willing to approve a limited, conditional concession with the following terms:

1) Hardware priority: Approve transient assignment of H200-class pool for up to 3 weeks (21 days) starting on the agreed window. We can allow a one-week extension (total 28 days) only if Optima signs the addendum and pays a pre-authorized buffer fee.

2) Reservation hold: Approve a soft reservation hold that prevents preemption during the primary 21-day window. This is conditional on Aditya confirming capacity is available and that we can guarantee no SLA impact to higher-tier customers.

3) Overage cap: Approve a capped overage surcharge set at 35% above committed rate for the transient buffer period. No longer-term commitment should be implied — any further discount or extension requires a Dedicated commit amendment.

4) Scope & guardrails: This approval is one-off, non-precedential, and must be documented in a short addendum to the MSA (RDW_transient_addendum_optima.docx). Lauren, please draft the clause limiting scope and duration. Aditya, confirm capacity availability and the exact SKU mapping (H200-equivalent => physical fleet).

If everyone is aligned I authorize Neha to communicate this to Optima and attach the addendum for countersignature.

— Kar
Karthik Iyer
VP, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@optimaai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval (conditional) — OptimaAI transient H200 priority and overage cap

Hi Sanjay —

Good news: Redwood has conditionally approved a one-off transient priority arrangement to support your go-live. Key terms (high level):
- Transient H200-class priority assignment: 8 GPUs reserved for a primary 21-day window.
- Soft reservation hold: prevents preemption during the primary window.
- Extension: one-week extension allowed if Optima executes the attached addendum and pays the buffer fee.
- Overage surcharge cap: 35% above committed Dedicated base rate for the transient buffer period.
- This concession is non-precedential and documented in the addendum (attached).

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the addendum via DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docsign/optima-2027-137
2) Confirm final capacity dates (we'll lock the window after DocuSign completes).
3) Aditya will follow up with activation schedule and SKU mapping.

Attachments: RDW_transient_addendum_optima.docx (stub); OptimaAI_MSA_redline_v3.pdf

Thanks — we'll prioritize this as soon as we have the signed addendum.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Director, Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@optimaai.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Green <maya.green@optimaai.com>, procurement@optimaai.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval (conditional) — OptimaAI transient H200 priority and overage cap

Neha / team —

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and the conditional approval. I've routed the addendum to our legal and procurement for signature; procurement has started the DocuSign flow and I attached the signed acknowledgement PDF here (DocuSign receipt). We will confirm the exact 21-day window by tomorrow morning but plan to target 2027-09-25 to 2027-10-16 with the optional extension week if needed.

Please have Aditya's team reach out with the activation checklist and any IP/endpoint allowlist requirements. We'll also need an invoice for the buffer fee once signed.

Thanks again — this is critical for our launch.

Sanjay Patel
Head of Infrastructure, OptimaAI
Attachment: OptimaAI_DocuSign_receipt.pdf
